description: This PHP source file defines the class TemplateEncrypt, which extends TemplateField, representing an encrypt-type custom field in the SuiteCRM system. It provides methods to save the field configuration and retrieve its database definition.

classes.name: TemplateEncrypt
classes.description: A class extending TemplateField to implement an encrypt field type in SuiteCRM, with methods to save its configuration and retrieve its database field definition.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sets the field type to 'encrypt', defines the database type as 'varchar', and calls the parent save method to handle persistence.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Retrieves the parent's field definition array and sets its 'dbType' to this field's extension type before returning.
